So my dad picked us up and that was the last time I saw my mother.  She was a lifelong drug addict and passed away from an OD at the age of 54.  
Thank you grandpa Richard for saving my brother and I from a life of turmoil.  You sincerely were our guardian angel by not allowing our mom to press charges against our dad,  not allowing her to search for us, and for always making sure that she didnt see us when we went to visit you for Christmas and other holidays.
